:::{#thm-bernoulli-lik-general}

#### Likelihood of independent binary outcomes

Let $\vy = (y_1, ..., y_n)$ be a data set of
mutually [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) [binary outcomes](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/data.html#def-binary-var),
$y_i \simind \Ber(\pi_i)$,
each with a potentially different event probability $\pi_i$.
Then the [likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-lik) of $\vy$ is:

$$\Lik(\vec \pi) = \prodin (\pi_i)^{y_i} (1-\pi_i)^{1-y_i}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-likelihood-general.

:::
